title: Analog Drums
description: In this exercise, I synthesized common drum sounds using analog methods of synthesis. All sounds were created in Phaseplant using an oscillator, or multiple, alongside basic filtering and envelope manipulation. These techniques model sounds similar to that found in hardware such as an 808 (minus the non-ideal characteristics circuit hardware introduces that we have come to appreciate).

audio.label: Latin Groove
audio.desc: A drum groove using instrumentation that could be labeled as 'Aux Percussion'. Think toms, congas, rim hits, shakers, etc.

audio.label: Drum Kit
audio.desc: A standard drum groove. Uses your traditional drum kit instruments like kick, snare, HH, etc.

audio.label: Mixed Groove
audio.desc: Another drum groove that has a mix of instruments from the two snippets shown above.
